turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Quick tangent. I'm negotiating my contract with the district next month.
That's between you and the district. I asked you a question about my son's zero. Who decided, and on what basis?
You negotiate for a living. Give me three tips. Quick ones.
You want me to coach you, while my son sits on a zero? Here's my only tip: withdraw it. Now tell me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that mark went in.
